metadata.name: TonalDepth
metadata.compatibility: Existing --td-* variables remain public through web 1.x.

tokens.$value: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

tokens.$description: The well cut deeper, for a single hero object. Same three parts as --td-inset-soft at greater strength, so 'deep' is always deeper than 'soft' in both themes.

modes.dark: inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.78), inset 4px 5px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.88), inset -2px -3px 8px rgba(255, 248, 230, 0.095)

tokens.$value: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(58, 48, 36, 0.20), inset 3px 3px 8px rgba(82, 70, 54, 0.34), inset -2px -2px 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88)
tokens.$description: The well: the plain surface pressed in. A lip on the cut upper edge, the shade falling from it, and the bounce off the lower wall. Stated absolutely with its own dark value rather than mixed over --td-shadow-*, because --td-shadow-light in dark is 0.062 and no percentage of it draws a carved edge.

modes.dark: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.62), inset 3px 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.72), inset -2px -2px 6px rgba(255, 248, 230, 0.070)

tokens.$value: inset 2px 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--td-shadow-dark) 46%, transparent), inset -1.5px -1.5px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--td-shadow-light) 62%, transparent)
tokens.$description: A row being reached for. Dark states its own values because --td-shadow-light is 6% there, which makes the carved edge invisible.

tokens.$value: inset 3px 3px 7px color-mix(in srgb, var(--td-shadow-dark) 62%, transparent), inset -2px -2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--td-shadow-light) 50%, transparent)
tokens.$description: A row held down. Deeper than hover in both modes, so the press is a step rather than a repeat.

tokens.$value: inset 2.5px 2.5px 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--td-shadow-dark) 54%, transparent), inset -1.5px -1.5px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--td-shadow-light) 56%, transparent)
tokens.$description: A row that rests recessed because it is the current one. Between hover and press, so a selected row still moves when pointed at.

tokens.$value: inset 0 0 0 0 rgb(from var(--td-shadow-dark) r g b / 0), inset 0 0 0 0 rgb(from var(--td-shadow-light) r g b / 0)
tokens.$description: The unlit rung. Two slots at zero alpha in the shadows' own colours, never transparent, so the ladder interpolates.

tokens.$value: 4px 5px 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--td-shadow-dark) 70%, transparent), -4px -5px 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--td-shadow-light) 95%, transparent), inset 0 1px 0 var(--td-shadow-veil), 0 0 0 1px var(--td-edge)

tokens.$description: Lamp glow radius on hover. The lamp is off at rest, so there is no rest value.
How much of the lamp's colour reaches the hover glow, as a color-mix percentage.
Lamp glow radius while pressed — the top of the ladder.
How much of the lamp's colour reaches the pressed glow, as a color-mix percentage.
Filament glow radius on hover. The filament is off at rest, so there is no rest value. A strip needs less blur per pixel of light than the dot lamp, because it is already spread along its long axis.
How much of the filament's colour reaches the hover glow, as a color-mix percentage. The strip goes to full colour on hover; this is the glow around it.
Filament glow radius while the tab is held — lit and staying lit after the pointer leaves.
How much of the filament's colour reaches the held glow, as a color-mix percentage.
The wide outer halo added for the press only. It sits under a white core, which is what makes the press read as hotter than the held state rather than merely wider.
How much of the filament's colour reaches the press halo, as a color-mix percentage. Full: the halo is the filament's own colour at strength, under a white core.
How much of the quiet ink reaches the unlit filament, as a color-mix percentage. A dead filament is grey glass — it carries no hue at all, only this.
How much white the filament takes at the moment of the press. This is the fourth step of the ladder: the strip goes white-hot rather than merely glowing wider.
The tight white core of the press, sitting inside the wider coloured halo.
The wide outer halo on press. Paired with the core so the pressed state is unmistakably brighter than hover.
Strength of the pressed halo, as a color-mix percentage of the lamp's colour.
The colour a lamp lights. Set per housing, or per instance via the `glow` prop, so one lamp can burn any category colour.

What a lamp is when it is OFF. A dead filament is grey glass, not a dim version of its colour — so the unlit rung carries no hue at all, and "inactive" reads as no light rather than as a quiet light. Override it on a saturated housing, where the surrounding fill is the ground and translucent white is the unlit ink.

Rung 2 of 4 - dim light. How much of the lamp's colour has reached the filament on hover, as a color-mix percentage against --td-lamp-unlit. The ladder is colour ONLY: no rung carries a shadow, because a halo behind a glyph is a smear on paper and invisible on a saturated fill, while a colour step always reads.

Rung 3 of 4 - the standing lit state: pressed, expanded, selected, current. Brighter than hover and deliberately short of the press, so the press still has somewhere to go. This is the rung that survives the pointer leaving. Rung 4 is var(--td-lamp-glow) itself: the lamp reaches its named light at the press and nowhere else, which is what stops the four rungs collapsing into three.

tokens.$value: drop-shadow(0 0 0 rgb(from var(--td-lamp-glow) r g b / 0)) drop-shadow(0 0 0 rgb(from var(--td-lamp-glow) r g b / 0))
tokens.$description: Lamp at rest. Two EXPLICIT zero shadows, not `none`: transitioning from `none` lets the engine invent a start value, which flashes a dark shadow behind the icon, and a state with a different shadow count snaps instead of interpolating.

tokens.$value: drop-shadow(0 0 var(--td-glow-hover-blur) color-mix(in srgb, var(--td-lamp-glow) var(--td-glow-hover-strength), transparent)) drop-shadow(0 0 0 rgb(from var(--td-lamp-glow) r g b / 0))
tokens.$description: Lamp on hover — a single soft bloom, with the halo slot held at zero so the shadow count matches every other state.

tokens.$value: drop-shadow(0 0 var(--td-glow-active-blur) color-mix(in srgb, var(--td-lamp-glow) var(--td-glow-active-strength), transparent)) drop-shadow(0 0 var(--td-glow-active-halo-blur) color-mix(in srgb, var(--td-lamp-glow) var(--td-glow-active-halo-strength), transparent))
tokens.$description: Lamp pressed — a solid core plus a wide halo. The two-part shadow is what makes press read as brighter than hover rather than merely larger.
